title: How do I unblock someone I previously blocked?
summary: Explains how to unblock a previously blocked user: open your block list in Settings/Privacy controls, select the user, and confirm. Also covers post-unblock guidance, including a 12-hour wait to block the same user again and tips if the user can’t be found.
